mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in real GDP growth signals a weakening economy that will produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings estimates are revised downward.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of instances when GDPC1 YoY growth is below 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the unemployment rate signals a weakening labor market and consumer spending power, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly negative in periods following a 0.5pp rise in UNRATE over 3 months (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: An accelerating rise in industrial production signals strengthening economic growth that will produce positive S&P 500 returns over the next month.
failure_condition: Rolling 1-month Rank IC remains below 0.1 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary policy that will produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as borrowing costs rise and discount rates applied to equity cash flows increase.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in housing starts signals a weakening housing market and consumer spending that will produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST declines > 10% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid acceleration in payroll employment growth signals a strengthening labor market and consumer spending power that will produce positive S&P 500 returns over the next month.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive in periods following 3-month PAYEMS growth acceleration to > 2% YoY (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in CPI inflation signals rising input costs for corporations that will compress profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY inflation exceeds 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in real retail sales signals weakening consumer spending that will produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as earnings estimates are revised downward.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 50% of instances when RSAFS declines > 5% YoY.
